C0524.title: Harbin Police Dismantle Free Smartband Scam Inflating COD Shipping Fees
C0524.summary: On September 5, 2018, Harbin police cracked a major telecom fraud case. The criminal ring posed as 'Three Squirrels' customer service to recruit agents, then shifted to offering free Huawei smartbands and self-balancing scooters under cash-on-delivery terms. Victims were defrauded by exorbitant shipping charges. The group continued operating under a micro-business model from a Harbin-based company
